item.summary: According to Flamman's own investigation, companies and people around Valuno's former chief executive, Daniel Sonesson, have continued to operate in payments, including services used by online casinos. Sweden's Economic Crime Authority has charged Sonesson with aggravated insider trading, and he denies wrongdoing, according to Svenska Dagbladet. The company and person links Flamman reports are the paper's own findings.

links.label: Two former Valuno executives charged with aggravated insider trading
